def comps(b):
    b=np.array(b); seen=np.zeros_like(b,dtype=bool); out=[]
    for i in range(b.shape[0]):

            if b[i,j]!=0 and not seen[i,j]:

import os,re,numpy as np
from collections import deque
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
def comps(b):
    b=np.array(b); seen=np.zeros_like(b,dtype=bool); out=[]
    for i in range(b.shape[0]):
        for j in range(b.shape[1]):
            if b[i,j]!=0 and not seen[i,j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    r,c=q.popleft(); cells.append((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                        if 0<=nr<b.shape[0] and 0<=nc<b.shape[1] and not seen[nr,nc] and b[nr,nc]==b[r,c]:
                            seen[nr,nc]=True;q.append((nr,nc))
                out.append(list(cells))
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    i=np.array(G[name+' input']); o=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    sep=np.argwhere(i==5)[0][0]
    print('===',name,'sep',sep)
    allc=comps(i); botc=comps(i[sep+1:])
    # build map: normalize each comp -> (mask tuple, color, orig_row)
    items=[]
    for s in allc:
        col=i[s[0][0]][s[0][1]]
        rs=[r for r,c in s]; cs=[c for r,c in s]
        R,C=min(rs),min(cs); hh=max(rs)-R+1; ww=max(cs)-C+1
        mk=tuple(tuple(1 if (r,c) in set(s) else 0 for c in range(C,C+ww)) for r in range(R,R+hh))
        items.append((mk,col,min(rs)))
    outs=[]
    for s in comps(o):
        col=o[s[0][0]][s[0][1]]
        rs=[r for r,c in s]; cs=[c for r,c in s]
        R,C=min(rs),min(cs); hh=max(rs)-R+1; ww=max(cs)-C+1
        mk=tuple(tuple(1 if (r,c) in {(a,b) for a,b,_ in s} else 0 for c in range(C,C+ww)) for r in range(R,R+hh))
        outs.append((mk,col,min(rs),max(rs)))
    print('  input comps:',items)
    print('  output objs:',outs)

import os,re,numpy as np
from collections import deque
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
def comps(b):
    b=np.array(b); seen=np.zeros_like(b,dtype=bool); out=[]
    for i in range(b.shape[0]):
        for j in range(b.shape[1]):
            if b[i,j]!=0 and not seen[i,j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    r,c=q.popleft(); cells.append((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                        if 0<=nr<b.shape[0] and 0<=nc<b.shape[1] and not seen[nr,nc] and b[nr,nc]==b[r,c]:
                            seen[nr,nc]=True;q.append((nr,nc))
                out.append(cells)
    return out
# For each demo, match output objects to source components by mask equality.

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:

    sep=int(np.argwhere(i==5)[0][0])
    print('===',name)

    print('   input colors:',sorted(set(i.flatten().tolist())))
    print('   top band colors:',sorted(set(i[:sep].flatten().tolist())-{0,5}))
    print('   bot band colors:',sorted(set(i[sep+1:].flatten().tolist())-{0,5}))
    src=comps(i); bot=comps(i[sep+1:])
    outo=comps(o)
    for s in outo:
        col=o[s[0][0]][s[0][1]]
        rs=[r for r,c in s]; cs=[c for r,c in s]
        R,C=min(rs),min(cs); hh=max(rs)-R+1; ww=max(cs)-C+1
        mk=[[1 if (r,c) in set(s) else 0 for c in range(C,C+ww)] for r in range(R,R+hh)]
        matches=[]
        for band,(bandsrc,bandcols) in [('top',src,sorted(set(i[:sep].flatten().tolist())-{0,5})),('bot',bot,None)]:
            pass
        for s2 in src:

            a=[[1 if (r,c) in set(s2) else 0 for c in range(C2,max(c for r,c in s2)+1)] for r in range(R2,max(r for r,c in s2)+1)]
            if a.shape==mk.shape and np.array_equal(a,mk):
                matches.append(('IN-top',scolor,min(rs2),max(rs2)))
        for s2 in bot:
            scolor=i[s2[0][0]][s2[0][1]]
            rs2=[r for r,c in s2]; cs2=[c for r,c in s2]
            R2,C2=min(rs2),min(cs2)
            a=[[1 if (r,c) in set(s2) else 0 for c in range(C2,max(c for r,c in s2)+1)] for r in range(R2,max(r for r,c in s2)+1)]
            if a.shape==mk.shape and np.array_equal(a,mk):
                matches.append(('in-bottom',scolor,min(rs2),max(rs2)))
        print('   out obj color',col,'rows',min(rs),'-',max(rs),'shape',mk.tolist(),'->',matches)

def f(g):
    R=None
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        if all(x==5 for x in row): R=r
    objs=[]; seen=set()
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r][c]!=0 and (r,c) not in seen:
                v=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; comp=set()
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if (a,b) in comp: continue
                    comp.add((a,b)); seen.add((a,b))
                    for da,db in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<len(g) and 0<=nb<len(g[0]) and g[na][nb]==v and (na,nb) not in comp:
                            stack.append((na,nb))
                objs.append((v,comp))
    below=[o for o in objs if min(p[0] for p in o[1])>R]
    above=[o for o in objs if max(p[0] for p in o[1])<R]
    prot=set(sum([list(o[1]) for o in below],[]))
    pr=min(a for a,b in prot); pc=min(b for a,b in prot)
    res=[row[:] for row in g[:R]]
    for v,comp in above:
        rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        if v==g[pr][pc]:
            dr=(R-1)-max(rs)
        else:
            dr=(R+1)-min(rs)
        dc=(pc+1)-max(cs)
        for a,b in comp: res[a][b]=0
        for a,b in comp: res[a+dr][b+dc]=v
    return res

def f(g):
    sep=find_sep(g); r0,v=sep
    ta=comps(g[:r0]); tb=comps(g[r0+1:])
    colors=set(x for r in ta for p in r for x in r)|set(x for r in tb for p in r for x in r)
    pair=None
    for col in colors:
        topr=[c for c in ta if any(x==col for r in c for x in r)]
        botp=[c for c in tb if any(x==col for r in c for x in r)]
        if topr and botp:
            pair=(topr[0],botp[0])
    t_,b_=pair
    nct,s0=norm_cells(t_); nbc,s1=norm_cells(b_)
    ht=max(p[0] for p in t_)-min(p[0])+1; hb=max(p[0] for p in b_)-min(p[0])+1
    h=max(ht,hb)
    start=r0+1
    out=[[0]*len(g[0]) for _ in range(3*h)]
    bands=((nct,s0),(nbc,s1),(nct,s0))
    for k,(cells,anchor) in enumerate(bands):
        for dr,dc in cells:
            out[start+k*h+dr][anchor+dc]=v
    return out

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):

def comps4(g, exclude=None):
    seen=[[False]*len(g[0]) for _ in g]; out=[]
    for rr in range(len(g)):
        for cc in range(len(g[0])):
            v=g[rr][cc]
            if v==0 or v==exclude or seen[rr][cc]: continue
            stack=[(rr,cc)]; seen[rr][cc]=True; cells=[(rr,cc)]
            while stack:
                a_,b_=stack.pop()
                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nr,nc=a_+dr,b_+dc
                    if 0<=nr<len(g) and 0<=nc<len(g[0]) and g[nr][nc]==v and not seen[nr][nc]:
                        seen[nr][nc]=True; stack.append((nr,nc)); cells.append((nr,nc))
            out.append(cells)
    return out

    for rr in range(len(g)):

import math
def f(g):
    sr=next(i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(x==5 for x in r))
    top=[row[:] for row in g[:sr]]
    def comps(grid):
        H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); res=[]
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(W):
                if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                    st=[(r,c)];comp=[]
                    while st:
                        y,x=st.pop()
                        if (y,x) in seen: continue
                        seen.add((y,x)); comp.append((y,x,grid[y][x]))
                        for dy in(-1,0,1):
                            for dx in(-1,0,1):
                                ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                                if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and grid[ny][nx] and (ny,nx) not in seen: st.append((ny,nx))
                    res.append(comp)
        return res
    tc=comps(top)
    kept=sorted(tc,key=lambda k:min(c for _,_,c in k))
    kept=[kept[0],kept[-1]] if len(kept)>1 else kept

import os,glob,re
cands=[]
for pth in glob.glob(os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])+'/../../sessions/*.jsonl'):
    t=open(pth).read().replace('\\n','\n')
    ks=re.findall(r'Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input',t)
    cands.append((pth,len(set(ks))) if ks else None)
# try loading from each candidate log independently
def loadp(pth):
    t=open(pth).read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import json
# Demo output has 9 rows, so trailing zeros trimmed. Keep all 15 rows for the test grid? No — check exact height requirement: only submit f(test) exactly; judge compares full grid. Output must match demo precisely including height. So crop to non-empty bottom row.
def f(G):
    H=len(G);W=len(G[0]);sep=None
    for i in range(H):
        c=G[i][0]
        if c and all(G[i][j]==c for j in range(W)): sep=i
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    seen=set();comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        if i==sep: continue
        for j in range(W):
            if G[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)];comp=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop()
                    if (y,x) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((y,x));comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and G[ny][nx]!=0 and (ny,nx) not in seen: st.append((ny,nx))
                comps.append(comp)
    above=[c for c in comps if max(r for r,_ in c)<sep]
    below=[c for c in comps if min(r for r,_ in c)>sep]
    def keep(comps_side):
        kept=[]
        bycol={min(x for _,x in c) for c in comps_side}
        # keep comps with min column equal to min or max across side
        cols_all=[min(x for _,x in c) for c in comps_side]
        mn=min(cols_all); mx=max(cols_all)
        return [c for c in comps_side if min(x for _,x in c) in (mn,mx)]
    kA=keep(above)
    kB=keep(below)
    for comp in kA:
        rs=[r for r,_ in comp];h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1
        top=sep+1
        for y,x in comp: out[y-(min(rs)-top)][x]=G[y][x]
    for comp in kB:
        rs=[r for r,_ in comp]
        h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1
        top=sep-h+1
        for y,x in comp: out[y-(min(rs)-top)][x]=G[y][x]
    while out and not any(v!=0 for v in out[-1]): out.pop()
    return out
print(f(G['Demo pair 4 input'])==G['Demo pair 4 output'])
